correctness.rationale: Rank-of-apparition and Lucas valuation theorem give v_p(U_n)=e+v_p(n/r) on multiples of r and zero otherwise at odd p, including ramification where r=p and e=1. Möbius transform is supported at r p^j with coefficients p^e-1 and p^(e+j-1)(p-1), nonnegative. Dold denominators yield minimal repair r/gcd(r,p-1). Split ranks divide p-1; inert ranks divide p+1 but exceed 2; ramified ranks p. Binary valuations differ by parity of P, yielding repairs 2 versus 3. Discriminant P^2+4 is nonsquare for P>=2, so Chebotarev/Dirichlet gives density 1/2. Independent direct recurrence and Möbius enumeration tested 77 (P,p) combinations for indices 1..120, corroborative only.

value.rationale: Extending the complete local dynamic realizability spectrum from only even P to all odd P, including the precise dyadic exception and optimal repair, closes a natural parity gap in a classical Lucas recurrence family. It gives exact all-prime orbit-count positivity and splitting-density results, not simply recomputation of one small index.

final_claim: For every integer P>=2 and prime p, the prime-part sequence p^v_p(U_n) for U_(n+2)=P U_(n+1)+U_n is Dold/realizable exactly at odd primes splitting in Q(sqrt(P^2+4)); all are almost realizable, with exact repair r_p/gcd(r_p,p-1) at odd primes, and repair 3 (odd P) or 2 (even P) at p=2.
